  "explanation": "L5.3 (g(x) = f(x) - x >= 0 for all x) is never proved. Section 1 only records the weak bound g(x) > -x; the standard iteration of (4) — f^n(x) = x + n g(x) > 0 for all n, forcing g(x) >= 0 — is nowhere written. Section 3's rational/irrational-ratio argument explicitly assumes two distinct POSITIVE values c_1 > c_2 > 0 (it iterates u + n c_1 forward), so it cannot exclude negative values or a mix of one positive and negative values. Hence the dichotomy V ⊆ {0} or V ⊆ {0, c} is a non sequitur, and (10)-(12), Lemma 1 ('b = g(z) ∈ {0,c}') and the covering argument all rest on it. One added sentence iterating (4) with positivity repairs it.",
